name: A confidential source
prompt: A man arrested on a gun charge says he can buy from the crew you're after, if the charge goes away.

choices.text: Meet him twice more before trusting what he says

outcome.told: Most of what he says checks out. You write down the rest and wait.

choices.text: Wire him and send him to make a buy

outcome.told: The buy is on tape, with the price and the name of who sets it.

failure.told: He doesn't come back that night. The crew moves its corner, and the source stops answering.
